غَلِثٌ and ↓ مُغَالِثٌ (S, O, K, TA) and ↓ غَالِثٌ (TA) A man who fights vehemently, (S, O, K, TA,) cleaving to him whom he pursues [for bloodrevenge or the like: see عَلِثٌ]. (TA.) ―
-b2- And the first, Possessed, or insane. (O, K.) ―
-b3- And One in whom is an odour arising from food and wine or beverage, and an inclining of the body from side to side, and a languor, or languidness, from drowsiness. (O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
